record.question: Which of the following is a primary advantage of CT scans over traditional X-rays?
record.explanation: Answer B: Ability to create 3D images. CT’s advantage over plain radiography is cross-sectional imaging and ability to reconstruct/display 3D anatomy; this option is best among those listed. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct; https://www.acr.org/Clinical-Resources/Clinical-Tools-and-Reference/Contrast-Manual. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
